AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
March 16, 2011
7:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Modification to Conditional Use Permit C-2001-05 and Precise Plan of Design P-2001-54 Applicant: Michael Chait, Representative of Laborers Training and Retraining Trust of Southern California
Location: 1385 W. Sierra Madre Avenue, Azusa CA 91702
Modification to the original Conditional Use Permit and Precise Plan of Design to allow the addition of a 5,000 sq. ft. educational building consisting of three new classrooms, four administrative offices and three indoor storage rooms on the campus of the Laborers Training School.

Location: 3751 Fish Canyon Road, Azusa CA 91702
A request for approval of a Use Permit to allow the construction and operation of an equestrian center in the OS (Open Space) zone.

3.
Development Code Amendment Number 232 Applicant: City of Azusa
Location: City wide
A City initiated request to amend various sections of Chapter 88, "Development Code, March 2005" of the City of Azusa Municipal Code. The proposed amendments involve minor adjustments, including by not limited to : allowable land uses, development standards, parking requirements and definitions to achieve consistency with California State Law and 2008-2014 Housing Element of the General Plan.
F-3 PC Staff Report & attachment 3-16-11
4.
Amendment to the Azusa Pacific University Specific Plan SP 7 - APU and Amendment to the SP7 - APU Development Agreement Applicant: Azusa Pacific University
Location: 801 E. Alosta Avenue, Azusa CA 91702
A request for an amendment to the Azusa Pacific University Specific Plan to expand the Specific Plan area to include the Crestview Apartments, located at 801 E. Alosta Avenue, in the DU-RMO (University District - Residential Moderate) zone.
